paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
notes: CASPEr-electric solid-state NMR search using 207Pb in PMN-PT crystal, mass range 162-166 neV (Compton freq ~39.65 MHz). Primary EDM coupling bound |g_d|<9.5e-4 GeV^-2 corresponds to oscillating nEDM amplitude 1.0e-21 e*cm (95% CL) and theta amplitude 4.3e-6. Gradient coupling bound |g_aNN|<2.8e-1 GeV^-1 also reported (AxionNeutron). Standard halo model with rho_DM=3.6e-42 GeV^4 (~0.4 GeV/cm^3, v0=220 km/s) assumed. The exact per-bin variation over the narrow 162-166 neV range is within line thickness; encoded as flat horizontal bound over stated mass range.
